credits.title: Tomorrow's Min-Jae
credits.overview: Min-Jae, a promising athlete, is driven to the edge when a teammate benefits from a wealthy background, and she takes action. When her coach learns her secret, she is offered a deal.

credits.title: The Vicious
credits.overview: Winning an apartment at auction could end her life as a tenant-if she can evict its stubborn occupant.

credits.overview: After Jiwoo, who lives with his grandmother, suddenly disappears, police investigation begins, and statements follow from children who claim they were harmed by Jiwoo's problematic behavior. credits.title: No Heaven, But Love.
credits.overview: 1999— The Age of Apocalypse, where violence was rampant. In those days, nothing was easy. A story about the love and friendship of girls, which was hotter than any other summer... Joo-young and Ye-ji’s relationship is tender but ultimately feels like an impossible one.

credits.title: Lost Target
credits.overview: Minjae, an archer nearing retirement, bets all the money she earned from match-fixing on her own loss. For her, this is the final match after an eight-year downward spiral following her last victory.

credits.title: A Good Boy
credits.overview: Soo-hyun, a fourth-year elementary school teacher, is about to get married. One day, Yohan, a student in her class, comes to Soohyun, who was busy and happy. Yohan confesses to Soohyun that he is experiencing domestic abuse. But the next day, John's lies await Soohyun.

credits.title: Other Life
credits.overview: An ordinary office worker, Kyuho, faces a dilemma when a famous writer asks him an embarrassing and uncomfortable question during an interview. He now has to find out why an old friend despises him.

credits.title: The Life and Death of Monty Jubei
credits.overview: Wansoo's wife goes to Japan with a Polynesian man named Monty Jubei to start a business. Wansoo, who remains in Korea, waits for his wife with faith, hope, and love. However, his wife doesn't seem to want to return to Korea for some reason.

credits.title: Aloners
credits.overview: Jina is the top employee at a credit card company call center. She avoids building close relationships, choosing instead to live and work alone – until she is suddenly tasked with training a new recruit.

credits.title: Pick-Up
credits.overview: Choo-hyeon, a film crew member, drives to pick up an actress, but ends up picking up a prostitute named Hee-ra by mistake.

credits.title: My Turn
credits.overview: It's not her turn, but she's pregnant.

credits.title: The Villainess
credits.overview: Honed from childhood into a merciless killing machine by a criminal organization, assassin Sook-hee is recruited with the promise of freedom after ten years of service. However, secrets from her past destroy everything she’s worked for and now she embarks on a roaring rampage of revenge.
